title: Real Estate Management
Application
page1.description: An AI-powered property discovery and transaction platform that lets buyers value, tour and secure a home with confidence.

page3.one_liner: One platform where buyers search, tour, and make offers and where you watch every listing move in real time.
description: The Kestrel Property App is an AI-powered property discovery and transaction platform for buyers, renters, and sellers who want to find, value, and secure their next home with confidence. It unites map-based search, instant valuations, 3D tours, mortgage pre-qualification, agent messaging, and seller-side listing management in one experience.

Buyers set their criteria, browse listings on an interactive map, walk through virtual tours, run affordability scenarios, save favourites, and request a viewing in a few taps. Meanwhile, agents and ownership gain real-time visibility into listing views, saved searches, and offer activity, plus a direct marketing layer to build a buyer database.

page4.one_liner: Know the price before you see the house.
page4.description: Every listing carries an instant valuation built from comparable sales, price history, and local trends. Buyers see whether a home is priced fairly before they book a viewing, and sellers see what the market will actually pay. Certainty up, wasted viewings down, negotiation stronger.

For over a decade, our senior team of designers, developers, and product thinkers has turned ideas into polished, scalable, market-ready products for startups and established businesses across the globe.

We don't just write code or design interfaces — we understand how products fit into people's lives.
